name: Kibana
covers: Status, spaces, dashboards, data views, alerting rules
credentialNote: A Kibana connection can pair with an Elasticsearch connection and use its API key, by naming it in apiKeyFrom

supported.note: toil calls /api/status, /api/spaces/space, /api/saved_objects/_find and _export, /api/data_views and the alerting rule APIs with an API key sent as an ApiKey header. Requests follow Elastic's current Kibana API reference; data-view list needs Kibana 8.0 or later. No release has been verified yet.
